sources.quote: Koin Games has included the following disclosure on Steam: "All card art, UI, writing, and audio are created by our team. AI-assisted tools are used internally for workflow tasks and temporary placeholders only. Non-English text in the game is translated with AI from our English writing. We believe an AI-assisted translation serves players better than English-only, and we improve it as we go. The game does not generate content with AI at runtime." The developers additionally acknowledge using AI-assisted images in some of the cinematic trailers, although they maintain that none of this footage appears in the actual game.
